chapters.title: Quick Start
chapters.body: Choose a folder in either pane. Enable Videos, Images and Include subfolders as needed. Use Details or Thumbnails, select or tick files, preview them, then copy, move, analyse or convert them. Ticked files form the action group; highlighting remains available for browsing and preview.

chapters.title: Browsing and Preview
chapters.body: Each pane has independent Back, Forward, Up and Refresh controls, filters, sorting, thumbnails, Info and Preview. Video preview starts at 4× speed. Comma and full stop move backward or forward ten percent. Preview and Info remain off until enabled to reduce background work.

chapters.title: Organising and Converting
chapters.body: Copy, move, rename, send files to the Recycle Bin or Trash, review duplicates, apply tags and ratings, export reports and create contact sheets. Conversion supports H.264, H.265 and AV1 with compatible hardware acceleration. Source files are retained and partial failed outputs are removed.

chapters.title: Language
chapters.body: On first launch the application follows the operating-system language when supported. Choose Tools > Language to override it or return to System default. Restart the application after changing language. Missing translations safely fall back to English.

chapters.title: Ratings and Optional Support
chapters.body: After five launches across at least three days, the app may invite you to rate it in Microsoft Store. Later postpones the request by ten launches. The optional coffee reminder begins at launch 11 and repeats every 11 launches only after Maybe later. Don't ask again disables either reminder; Tools > Reminders can re-enable it. A page opens only after you press its explicit button.

chapters.title: Privacy and Troubleshooting
chapters.body: Scanning, previews, thumbnails, metadata, reminders and file operations remain local. The app has no account, advertising or analytics and never uploads your media or launch history. If scanning is slow, disable unused previews, choose Quiet performance or narrow the folder. Refresh after external changes. Use Verify media integrity for unreadable files.
